[[File:Directions-TEA.png|thumb|right|200px|The trailing direction was opposite to the spinward direction.]]
In [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cartography and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], '''trailing''' was the opposite direction to [[spinward]]. It shared its name with the region known as the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as well as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Trailing Grant sector/Legends|Trailing Grant sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
